name: Saint Margaret of Scotland
history: An English princess who married King Malcolm III of Scotland. She reformed the Church in Scotland, founded the abbey at Dunfermline and the Queen's Ferry for pilgrims to Saint Andrews, and fed the poor at her own table before she ate.
meditation: Holiness in marriage and family life: do one thing today for those you live with.
